_key.description: SHA-256 hash of the variant key, Ensembl gene ID and eQTL Catalogue dataset identifier.

biological_process.title: Biological Process
biological_process.description: Gene Ontology term for the process this edge represents: regulation of gene expression for eQTLs, regulation of RNA splicing for spliceQTLs.

molecular_trait_id.title: Molecular Trait ID
molecular_trait_id.description: Identifier of the molecular trait used for QTL mapping: an Ensembl gene ID for gene-expression QTLs, or a Leafcutter intron cluster ID for splice QTLs.

credible_set_id.title: Credible Set ID
credible_set_id.description: SuSiE credible-set identifier for this signal within the dataset.

variant_chromosome_position_ref_alt.title: Variant Chromosome, Position, Reference, and Alternate Alleles
variant_chromosome_position_ref_alt.description: Variant identifier as chromosome, position, reference and alternate alleles, underscore-separated, on GRCh38.

rsid.title: dbSNP ID
rsid.description: dbSNP id for the variant position

credible_set_size.title: Credible Set Size
credible_set_size.description: Number of variants in the SuSiE credible set.

posterior_inclusion_probability.title: Posterior Inclusion Probability
posterior_inclusion_probability.description: Posterior inclusion probability that this variant is causal for the molecular trait, from SuSiE fine-mapping.

p_value.title: P-Value
p_value.description: Nominal p-value of association between the variant and the molecular trait.

neg_log10_pvalue.title: Negative Log10 P-Value
neg_log10_pvalue.description: Negative log 10 p-value of the measurement or prediction

effect_size.title: Effect Size
effect_size.description: Regression coefficient of the alternate allele on the molecular trait.

standard_error.title: Standard Error
standard_error.description: Standard error of the effect size.

credible_set_min_r2.title: Credible Set Minimum R-Squared
credible_set_min_r2.description: Smallest linkage-disequilibrium r2 between any two variants in the credible set.

intron_chr.title: Intron Chromosome
intron_chr.description: Chromosome of the spliced intron, as recorded in the molecular trait identifier, without a chr prefix.

intron_start.title: Intron Start
intron_start.description: Start position of the spliced intron.

intron_end.title: Intron End
intron_end.description: End position of the spliced intron.
